units.source_text: 朱雀院读了栉端上的诗，无限感慨，恨不得教年光倒流，回复到在位的当年。

en.t: After reading the poem on the end of the comb box, the Suzaku Retired Emperor was overcome with emotion and wished he could turn back the years to the time when he still reigned.

units.source_text: 他心中不免怨恨源氏内大臣不替他玉成斋宫之事。

en.t: In his heart, he could not help resenting Genji, the Minister of the Center, for not helping him bring about the matter with the Saigu.

units.source_text: 但这恐怕是昔年放逐源氏的报应了。

en.t: But perhaps this was retribution for having exiled Genji in earlier years.

units.source_text: 朱雀院所藏画幅，经过前太后之手而转入弘徽殿女御宫中者，

en.t: Among the paintings once kept by the Suzaku Retired Emperor, those that had passed through the former Empress Dowager's hands and entered the apartments of the Kokiden Consort

units.source_text: 还有尚侍胧月夜，也是热爱书画的雅人，所藏精品甚多。

en.t: Oborozukiyo, the Naishi no Kami, was also a person of refined taste who deeply loved calligraphy and painting, and she possessed many fine works.
